system.description:
Mounts and Vehicles (Passive): Mounts and vehicles are particularly useful for travel (the travel rules cover them). Mounts in Sacadia vary by region and culture; your Cultural Tapestry may say which. If not, the default mount is a Helk (a large elk that can be ridden).

No Item Slot · 2800gc · Mounts and Vehicles, rulebook p.201
